fields.summary: The shipit work plan for task 3: typed entry bodies, the six operations, folding a change set's entries in causal order into its current operations and lifecycle state, and fractional sibling keys, as pure packages (internal/key, op, changeset). Decided (D1-D16, agent wording accepted by the owner): pure domain packages only, no CLI, projection or index; each operation keeps one stable ID, a later ops entry replaces it by repeating the ID and drops operations through a drop list, and a replacement keeps its position, op type and target, a dropped ID never returning; ops entries are allowed in draft, proposed and accepted without resetting the state; a record change set lands from draft, proposed or accepted, an intention change set only from accepted; folding orders entries causally with ties by entry ID, skips and reports illegal entries and concurrent lifecycle entries, and never fails; bodies are strict like the envelope and the corpus is amended to match; node fields are free snake_case names to any JSON value, per-kind requirements deferred, the handle one slug segment; nine node kinds, with change sets not nodes but allowed as link endpoints; accept and reject bodies are {rule, reason}, the reason may be empty; tests are TDD with table tests, fuzzed body decoding, rapid properties and a clean corpus fold; guardrails keep the envelope and store APIs, add no dependencies and no filesystem or git access; no CONTEXT.md glossary. Per-kind field schemas were left for later.
fields.title: Shipit plan, milestone 1 task 3: change sets
